notes: Manufacturer cut-sheet (TOA/ProAcoustics) is the authoritative source, cross-checked against TOA's official product page (toaelectronics.com) and Markertek's spec listing — all three agree. The unit also has eight card-edge module bays on the rear panel (labeled "Input #1" to "#8") that accept over 50 optional plug-in modules (mic preamp, line, phono, transformer, etc.); these are proprietary edge-connector slots, not a fixed cable connector, so they are NOT included as ports above since "card-edge" has no equivalent in the allowed connector list and the actual field-facing connector type is undetermined until a module is installed (e.g., an M-series mic module would expose an XLR3 or terminal block on its own faceplate). This is the single biggest caveat: the device's true signal I/O is modular/user-configurable per slot. No grade fields apply — none of the physical ports are on a bandwidth-graded connector family (no HDMI/SDI/DisplayPort/USB/Ethernet). Power is captive AC cord (SJT/3-prong), so nema-5-15 was used as the closest match to a captive-cord US mains connector; a pass-through convenience AC outlet is also present on the rear panel. Screw-terminal strips (output speaker terminals, mute, remote VR) were mapped to "euroblock" as the closest connector id in the allowed list.
